title: Open a root shell using pkexec
summary: Use pkexec without arguments to open a new shell session as the root user. This allows you to run multiple commands with administrator privileges.

steps.explain: Start a new interactive shell session as the root user. You will likely need to enter your password in a graphical prompt.

rollback.explain: Type 'exit' in the root shell to return to your normal user session.

warnings: You are operating as the root user. Mistakes can damage the system. Type 'exit' to leave the root shell.
